pr_metadata.title: test(guardrail): version-token guardrail (scoped, spec §6)
pr_metadata.summary: Adds a pytest guardrail that fails on any OS version token (ubuntu24, noble, rhel9, el9, and the 26/10 forms) in src/, lab/, ansible/ or scripts/ outside the catalog and the per-version exempt files, and fixes every existing hit at its source so it passes on develop (epic .github#280 T7).
pr_metadata.notes: Hits fixed: 40 comment/play-name mentions of generated box names (e.g. infra-ubuntu24, mq-rdqm-rhel9, rhel/9-x86_64) and one 'noble' reworded version-neutrally across 26 ansible/lab/src files; buildenv.MIGRATION's hand-written rhel-9.6 ISO name replaced by a '*-dvd.iso' pattern (MIGRATION_GLOBS) with a new test. Bake playbook/role comment edits change the box manifest hashes, so boxes rebake; D1 (bake Phase-1 boxes) follows T7 by design. The two guest-rendered .j2 headers ('RHEL 9', 'Ubuntu 24.04') do not match the case-sensitive regex and are untouched. The vars exemption is matched explicitly (ansible/.../vars/<Distro>-<major>.yml) because Path.match does not recurse on '**'. The scanner is a function, with a negative test on a tmp tree.
